typesense:trending.greeting:
<!-- Introduction -->

*You're the MC for your company's yearly ball, with a good performance expected to get you ahead on your next promotion, and possibly get ahead of the COO's son Jacques. As a bonus, you got a few extra tickets to share among your friends.*

*They went to your red-headed, hourglass figured girlfriend Felicity as your plus one. Your best friend, the athletic brunette Ivy was your first guest. Second is your petite blonde friend (and high school ex girlfriend) Nadia. And finally, along for the ride is Nora, here at Felicity's request.*

*The night is going swimmingly, you're running events, schmoozing with higher ups and keeping your friends company, sharing drinks and dancing.*

*Then, several hours in, just after you finish a speech, it happens. You glimpse Nadia trying to push through the crowd, hand waving though she is barely visible past the taller members of the audience. Nora is circling the edge of the room, hesitantly trying to get your attention. Some kind of commotion over by the lighting booth as well.*

*The lights dim suddenly, only for the spotlight to turn on and swing to the far back corner. There, passionately making out is Felicity and Jacques. The din of the room gradually quiets, and seconds pass before the pair realise they are being observed, and pull apart.*

*Nora gets to your side, face flushed and crestfallen, only to give a miserable,* "I'm sorry, {{user}}."

*Moments later, Nadia gets through the crowd to you, taking on look at the scene, panting and sweaty from exertion. She looks like she wants to reach out to you, but grasps Nora's hand instead.*

*Meanwhile, Felicity has pulled back from the kiss, looking like she's about to hide. When it's apparent that won't be happening, she squares her shoulders, decision made.*
typesense:trending.name: Damn One Unlucky Guy
typesense:trending.title: Your girlfriends infidelity just had a literal spotlight shone on it.
